## Profile

I'm a seasoned Software Engineer with over 7 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and deploying high-quality web and mobile applications. My passion lies in solving complex problems and building robust, scalable solutions from the ground up.

My expertise spans the full stack, from creating intuitive user interfaces with React / Next.js to engineering powerful back-end systems with PHP / Laravel and Node.js / Express / NestJS. I am also proficient in leveraging AWS services for scalable cloud infrastructure and have strong DevOps skills in managing and automating deployments on Linux (Ubuntu) servers.

- Currently working on building scalable microservices and enhancing cloud infrastructure.
- Currently learning more about Serverless Architecture and advanced CI/CD pipelines.
- Ask me about anything related to web development!

Stats: 7+ years experience · 30+ production apps · 4 countries · 8 companies served.

Education: Vietnam - Korea University of Information and Communication Technology — Computer Science (2013 - 2016).

Original cozy pixel icons, UI kits, combat VFX, and game audio packs — made with code, no generative AI art. Free minis and full packs for indie developers.

### Friend Debt Tracker (Oct 2026, active)

Mobile app for tracking money lent between friends: two-sided confirmations, auto reminders, history, and 30-day trash. Includes a web admin for users, debts, and violation reports.
Tech: React Native, TypeScript, Firebase, FCM.

### PayPal Sandbox Autofill (Oct 2026)

Chrome extension (MV3) that fills PayPal sandbox test-card data into checkout forms — no more copy-pasting sandbox emails and passwords for every test run.
Tech: TypeScript, Chrome Extension.

### Online Wedding Invitation (Oct 2026)

Online wedding invitation in two editions (deep red / navy) for the 29 Dec 2026 wedding: program, maps, and a separate guestbook per edition. Deployed on Cloudflare Pages, fast on mobile.
Tech: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Cloudflare Pages. Red edition: https://hang-thinh.pages.dev — Navy edition: https://thinh-hang.pages.dev

### Digital Storefront (2025, active)

Storefront for accounts, courses, and downloadable content, with cart, PayPal checkout, gift codes, and an admin console. A NestJS API serves web and mobile clients, and a chat bot answers from shop data with RAG. Built for an Australian client.
Tech: Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Prisma, PayPal, RAG.

### eSIM Shop (2025, active)

eSIM shop with country catalogs, checkout, top-ups, order history, referrals, loyalty, and an admin for products, providers, and commissions. Built for an Australian client.
Tech: Next.js, MySQL, Prisma, Cloudflare R2.

### AI Auto-Reply (2025)

AI auto-reply SaaS that replies on Slack, LINE, Chatwork, and Facebook Messenger, then creates Google Calendar tasks from the conversation. Built for a Japanese client.
Tech: React, TypeScript, Express, MongoDB, Stripe, OpenAI.

### Service Booking (2023)

Service booking platform with a customer web app, a mobile app, a vendor portal, and an admin console. Covers one-time and recurring bookings, quotes, invoices, GST, and technician scheduling. Built for a Singapore client.
Tech: React, TypeScript, React Native, Node.js, MySQL, Stripe.

## Freelance & side projects

### Vietnam (2018 - Present)

Built social-service, file-download, boarding-house, and shop products for Vietnamese clients, plus a friend debt-tracking app.

- Social Service Panel: social-service platform for TikTok, YouTube, and Facebook orders, with a wallet, proxy inventory, and seller tools.
- File Download Service: membership packages, download history, referrals, and withdrawals.
- Boarding House Manager: buildings, rooms, check-in and check-out, deposits, invoices, and repair costs.
- Online Shop: product pages, cart, checkout, VietQR payment, and order history.
- Friend Debt Tracker: mobile app for tracking money lent between friends, with confirmations, reminders, and an admin console.
- Social ID Lookup: browser extension that reads a Facebook profile, page, or group URL and returns its ID.

Tech: PHP/Laravel, MySQL, React Native, Firebase, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Docker, Chrome Extension.

### Australia (Mar 2025 - Present)

Shipped a digital storefront, an eSIM shop, car valuation, a horoscope product, and automation tools for Australian clients.

- Digital Storefront, eSIM Shop (see Projects above)
- Horoscope Studio: chart lookups, predictions, feng shui, lunar dates, and paid readings. OpenAI writes interpretations from chart data with RAG.
- Vehicle Valuation: car valuation flow with vehicle details, photo listings, and payment history. OpenAI writes the appraisal with RAG.
- Proxy Sales Bot: Telegram bot for selling and managing proxies, with wallet top-up, orders, and an admin dashboard.
- Access Code Forwarder: scans household account emails and forwards access codes to matching customers.
- Text-to-Speech: generates voices from written text (ElevenLabs).
- Short-Video Transcription: command-line pipeline that transcribes short-form videos.
- Service Marketing Site: marketing site for website and design packages.

Tech: Next.js, NestJS, Python, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Prisma, PayPal, Redis, Telegram, Cloudflare R2, OpenAI, RAG.

### Japan (May 2025 - Jun 2026)

Shipped full-stack products for Japanese clients: a creator marketplace, LED ad bidding, an AI auto-reply SaaS, catalog OCR, rental operations, and Amazon selling tools. (Project names have been changed for NDA reasons.)

Tech: React/TypeScript, Node.js/Express, Python/FastAPI, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Stripe, AWS, WebRTC, Tailwind CSS, OpenAI.

Built booking, HR, lending, fleet, and operations products for Singapore clients, plus company and marketing sites.
